results.question: If I am an Electrical Engineering (EE) student, which hardware or embedded companies can I apply to?

response.text:
Based on the provided documents, there is no explicit list specifying by name which hardware or embedded companies an Electrical Engineering (EE) student can apply to. 

However, regarding eligibility rules for EE students (who belong to CORE branches: Civil, EE, MECH, Mechatronics, Automobile, Aerospace, and Chemical) [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf]:
* You can avail a maximum of **two offers from core companies** [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf].
* If you receive your **first offer in a core company/core profile**, you **shall not be allowed to participate in IT/ITES companies** [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf].
* If you have a core offer, you are allowed to participate in further core companies that have a CTC **more than or equal to double of the existing CTC** [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf].
* If you receive your **first offer in an IT company**, you are allowed to participate in core companies until you get one offer in a core company [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf].
* You can also avail a maximum of **one IT/ITES offer** [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf].
* If you register for a campus process, you must mandatorily participate in the drive, or you will be disqualified from attending the next campus drive [Page 4 — T&P Regulations_2027 Batch.pdf].

For specific company names or drives open to your branch, please contact the T&P cell.
